about: Every role the Google Cloud setup needs, who needs it, where it goes, and the permissions it is needed for. One source: abstract-gcp-setup.sh --grant reads it, step 2 checks it, and the app and docs/public/gcp/STEP-BY-STEP.md render it. `permissions` are the ones the setup actually uses from the role; a check asks Google whether they are held, through any route (directly, through a group, or inherited). `kind` is where the binding goes: scope (the organization, folder or project the sink is at), project (the logging project), billing (the billing account), service_account (the Infrastructure Manager service account). `steps` are the guided script's step numbers. Check every role and permission against Google with: python3 tools/gcp-guided-setup/permissions.py verify

setup.title: You, or whoever runs the setup
setup.for: The guided script, the Google Cloud console click path, the gcloud commands and a local Terraform apply all run as you, so they all need these.

infra-manager.title: You, to deploy with Infrastructure Manager
infra-manager.for: Infrastructure Manager runs Terraform as its own service account. You need only enough to create that account, let yourself act as it, and start the deployment.

infra-manager-sa.title: The Infrastructure Manager service account
infra-manager-sa.for: What the deployment creates, it creates as this account: the topic, the subscription, the sink, Abstract's service account, and the grants on them.

bind.about: The one command that adds one binding, per kind of resource; MEMBER and ROLE are filled in. abstract-gcp-setup.sh --grant prints the same commands (tools/templates/tests/test_gcp_permissions.py compares them). --condition=None stops gcloud asking which binding is meant when the policy holds conditional ones; billing accounts take no --condition.
